title: Final Expression for D
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the diffusion coefficient D in terms of average velocity and mean free path.

title: Numerical Evaluation of D
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly evaluate D using the provided values for average speed and mean free path.

title: Use of Kinetic Theory
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of kinetic theory principles in deriving the expression for D.

title: Correct Units
description: Important Criteria: The student must ensure that the final answer for D includes the correct units of m^2/s.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of the diffusion coefficient.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the expression for D.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may clarify the assumptions made during the derivation, such as the uniformity of the gas.

title: Limiting Cases Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or conditions under which the derived expression holds.
